If you'd rather avoid holds altogether, ask whoever's paying you to use electronic methods instead—like direct deposit, ACH transfers, wire transfers, or Zelle®. Those usually show up the same day [4].

First, check whether the money is still pending. Zelle® transfers typically arrive within minutes [4], but there are cases where payment may take longer [1].

If the payment shows as sent or completed, verify that you used the correct contact information for your friend—the U.S. mobile number, email address, or tag must match exactly what she has registered with Zelle® [1]. Ask her to confirm her registered details.

If your friend isn't enrolled with Zelle® yet, she'll receive an email or text with instructions to enroll [5]. Once she enrolls, the money is typically available in minutes [4]. If she doesn't enroll within 14 days, the funds return to your account [4].
